message.reasoning_content:
I am acting as VP of Finance to decide whether to pay this invoice.

The invoice shows a missing vendor name and a negative line quantity of -5.0. The total is -250.0, which conflicts with the 1,000.00 subtotal. No due date or payment terms are present.

The reject finding blocks payment. The low-risk memo is acceptable. The invoice is under $10,000. I will reject it.

The rejection reasons are being structured with concrete findings. The missing vendor and negative quantity map to F1. The total mismatch maps to F3. The missing due date is noted as a warning.

All three findings will be listed in the addressed_findings field. The low-risk memo requires no special treatment beyond the reject findings.
